status_note: Spacebase-relative STORE/LOAD reindex fixture. Root cause: Rugra's httpd runner constructed Funcdata without an Architecture, so RuleLoadVarnode::correctSpacebase/RuleStoreVarnode (ruleaction.cc:4173-4341) took the Option-None miss branch for the input-RSP case and spacebase-relative STORE/LOAD never reindexed into the stack space (printed as raw *(..)(in_RSP-8) pointer expressions; 148 in_RSP lines corpus-wide). Fix: examples/httpd_decompile.rs attaches the canonical x86-64 Architecture via fd.set_arch before inject_raw_ops, mirroring the oracle invariant (glb = scope->getArch(), funcdata.cc:48) that the headless oracle (which produced tests/golden/ghidra_httpd_1204.c with full provenance) satisfies by construction. Observable verified: corpus in_RSP lines 148 -> 0 (golden has 0); ap_parse_vhost_addrs surviving LOAD/STORE after pipeline 7 -> 1 (the survivor is INT_ADD(in_RDX,param_1)+0x60, a legitimate non-stack pointer, matching golden's *(param_3 + 0x60) form); push/pop prologue STOREs now fold to stack-space COPYs and dead-eliminate. Per-function B2 status: MISMATCH with registered differences — the pinned comparands still differ by skeleton diff 46 (param inference 6->2 vs golden 3, loop-rotation shape, deref print form *param_1 + 0x60), which belong to PARAM-INFERENCE/PRINTC-DEREF/loop-structure gap families outside this TODO's write-set; the spacebase-fold observable itself is zero-diff. Deterministic regression runner: examples/stackfold_dbg.rs (exit 0; stderr census 'total surviving LOAD/STORE: 1' with RUGRA default arch present; '7' reproduces the pre-fix break only by removing the set_arch call).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: RuleStoreVarnode::applyOp (ruleaction.cc:4319-4341) creates the stack-space output via data.newVarnodeOut(size, Address(baseoff, offoff), op), removes STORE inputs 1 and 0, sets opcode COPY and marks the output setStackStore; RuleLoadVarnode::applyOp (cc:4277-4305) symmetric via data.newVarnode(size, baseoff, offoff); correctSpacebase (cc:4173-4184) requires vn->isSpacebase() && vn->isInput() and resolves glb->getSpaceBySpacebase(addr,size) with assoc->getContain() == the STORE/LOAD spaceid space; Funcdata::spacebase() (funcdata.cc:230-269) marks ALL varnodes at the spacebase register location (not just input) so written-RSP chains collapse onto the input spacebase first.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: vnSpacebase (cc:4194-4227) tries getIn(0) as spacebase then getIn(1); Funcdata::spacebase iterates beginLoc/endLoc per spacebase record ascending (cc:248-250); no per-prefix or split counting is involved in the reindex itself.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters; the reindex is per-op idempotent (converted STORE no longer matches CPUI_STORE oplist on later passes).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: getSpaceBySpacebase matches (space, offset, size) equality against the stackpointer record (Architecture fields: Stack space, Register:0x20, size 8 for x86-64-gcc.cspec); word_size conversions use AddrSpace::addressToByte/byteToAddress.
